title: ProcedureInfo
description: One curated procedure, keyed by code. Produced by the pipeline from /data/procedure_list.csv. Drives filtering of all other pipeline stages.

code_system.description: Which coding system `code` belongs to, if known.

category.description: Grouping category, or null if none.

typical_max_units.description: Typical maximum units for this procedure where known, else null. Never a placeholder.
